notes: A REVISED DECISION GOVERNS, AND THE SURFACE NOW SAYS SO. book.allocation.superseded has its producer: when the SAME handler (rule) publishes a new allocation decision for the SAME subject and phase, the supersession is recorded as its own event naming WHICH replaced WHICH — both decision events stand, nothing is edited or retracted, and the prior decision is found in the log itself (a bounded read inside the log's own EVENT_LOG_MAX_RANGE_DAYS window; a handler silent longer than that has no working order to confuse).
